_meta.description: Mobile-Agent-v3 框架缺陷归因模板，支持 Initial Root Cause 和 Recovery Root Cause 双维度分析

framework.label: 框架问题
framework.description: Framework 层面的缺陷，可以通过架构设计、模块逻辑或模块协同机制进行优化

manager.label: Manager（规划器）
manager.description: 高层规划模块，负责将用户指令分解为子目标、跟踪进度、修订计划、检测任务完成

wrong_goal.label: 目标错误
wrong_goal.description: 规划了错误的子目标或动作

premature_termination.label: 过早终止
premature_termination.description: 任务未完成时就判定为完成

failure_to_terminate.label: 未能终止
failure_to_terminate.description: 任务已完成但未终止，继续执行多余操作

wrong_planning.label: 规划错误
wrong_planning.description: 规划策略错误，导致无法达成目标

incorrect_state_understanding.label: 状态理解错误
incorrect_state_understanding.description: 对当前应用状态的理解错误

insufficient_recovery_strategy.label: 恢复策略不足
insufficient_recovery_strategy.description: 错误发生后，缺乏有效的恢复策略

no_goal_state_verification.label: 缺少目标状态验证
no_goal_state_verification.description: 没有显式验证当前状态是否满足目标状态

executor.label: Executor（执行器）
executor.description: 动作决策模块，负责基于当前计划和页面状态选择具体的原子操作

wrong_target.label: 目标选择错误
wrong_target.description: 选择了错误的交互对象

wrong_coordinate.label: 坐标错误
wrong_coordinate.description: 点击或滑动的坐标错误

wrong_action.label: 动作类型错误
wrong_action.description: 选择了错误的动作类型

wrong_parameter.label: 参数错误
wrong_parameter.description: 动作参数错误（如长按时间、滑动距离等）

insufficient_target_disambiguation.label: 目标区分不足
insufficient_target_disambiguation.description: 缺乏足够的目标区分机制

invalid_action_format.label: 动作格式错误
invalid_action_format.description: 动作生成模块输出不符合约定的语法或必需结构，如JSON括号、引号不闭合或缺少必需字段，导致无法解析。可解析但参数值错误仍属参数错误；合法输出被适配器错误拒绝不属本项。

reflector.label: Reflector（反思器）
reflector.description: 验证模块，负责对比动作前后截图，判断动作是否产生预期效果

failure_detection_failure.label: 失败检测失败
failure_detection_failure.description: 未能检测到动作执行失败

wrong_outcome.label: 结果判断错误
wrong_outcome.description: 错误判断了动作的结果

detected_failure_no_trigger.label: 检测到失败但未触发恢复
detected_failure_no_trigger.description: 检测到失败但未触发恢复机制

insufficient_failure_feedback.label: 失败反馈不足
insufficient_failure_feedback.description: 提供的失败反馈信息不足以支持有效恢复

notetaker.label: Notetaker（记录器）
notetaker.description: 记录模块，负责记录操作历史和关键信息

under_recording.label: 记录不足
under_recording.description: 记录信息不足，导致后续决策缺乏上下文

repeated_failure_no_learning.label: 重复失败未学习
repeated_failure_no_learning.description: 重复相同错误，未能从历史中学习

controller.label: Controller（控制器）
controller.description: 设备控制模块，负责将逻辑动作翻译为 ADB/HDC 命令并在物理设备上执行

app.label: App问题
app.description: App 自身的异常行为，非 Framework 能力不足导致

operation_no_response.label: 操作无响应
operation_no_response.description: Agent 执行了正确操作，但 App 无任何响应

incorrect_navigation.label: 跳转错误
incorrect_navigation.description: Agent 执行了正确操作，但 App 跳转到了非预期页面

unexpected_popup.label: 意外弹窗
unexpected_popup.description: 非预期的系统或应用弹窗打断了任务

page_load_timeout.label: 页面加载超时
page_load_timeout.description: 页面持续处于加载状态，无法进入可交互状态

app_crash.label: 应用崩溃
app_crash.description: 应用闪退或被系统强制关闭

state_reversal.label: 状态回退
state_reversal.description: 之前已完成的操作结果被非预期地撤销

precondition.label: 预置问题
precondition.description: 任务所需账号、内容、功能、匹配结果或业务条件不满足；需有可核查证据，不等同于App异常

framework.label: Framework Issue
framework.description: Deficiencies at the Framework level that can be optimized through architecture design, module logic, or module coordination mechanisms

manager.label: Manager (Planner)
manager.description: High-level planning module responsible for decomposing user instructions into subgoals, tracking progress, revising plans, and detecting task completion

premature_termination.label: Premature Termination
premature_termination.description: Determined task as completed before it was actually done

failure_to_terminate.label: Failure to Terminate
failure_to_terminate.description: Task was completed but did not terminate, continued executing unnecessary operations

wrong_planning.label: Wrong Planning
wrong_planning.description: Planning strategy error, preventing goal achievement

incorrect_state_understanding.label: Incorrect State Understanding
incorrect_state_understanding.description: Incorrect understanding of current application state

insufficient_recovery_strategy.label: Insufficient Recovery Strategy
insufficient_recovery_strategy.description: Lacked effective recovery strategy after error occurred

no_goal_state_verification.label: No Goal-State Verification
no_goal_state_verification.description: Did not explicitly verify whether current state satisfies goal state

executor.label: Executor
executor.description: Action decision module responsible for selecting specific atomic operations based on current plan and page state

wrong_coordinate.label: Wrong Coordinate
wrong_coordinate.description: Click or swipe coordinate was incorrect

wrong_parameter.label: Wrong Parameter
wrong_parameter.description: Action parameter error (e.g., long press duration, swipe distance)

invalid_action_format.label: Invalid Action Format
invalid_action_format.description: The action-generating module emits invalid action syntax or required structure, such as unclosed JSON delimiters or missing mandatory fields, preventing parsing. Parseable but incorrect argument values remain Wrong Parameter; adapter rejection of valid output is excluded.

reflector.label: Reflector
reflector.description: Verification module responsible for comparing before/after screenshots to determine if action produced expected result

failure_detection_failure.label: Failure Detection Failure
failure_detection_failure.description: Failed to detect that action execution failed

detected_failure_no_trigger.label: Detected Failure No Trigger
detected_failure_no_trigger.description: Detected failure but did not trigger recovery mechanism

insufficient_failure_feedback.label: Insufficient Failure Feedback
insufficient_failure_feedback.description: Provided insufficient failure feedback to support effective recovery

notetaker.label: Notetaker
notetaker.description: Recording module responsible for recording operation history and key information

under_recording.label: Under Recording
under_recording.description: Insufficient information recorded, causing subsequent decisions to lack context

repeated_failure_no_learning.label: Repeated Failure No Learning
repeated_failure_no_learning.description: Repeated same errors, failed to learn from history

controller.label: Controller
controller.description: Device control module responsible for translating logical actions into ADB/HDC commands and executing on physical device

app.label: App Issue
app.description: Abnormal App behavior, not caused by Framework capability deficiencies

app_abnormal.label: App Abnormal
app_abnormal.description: Abnormal behavior of the App itself

operation_no_response.label: Operation No Response
operation_no_response.description: Agent executed correct operation, but App had no response

incorrect_navigation.label: Incorrect Navigation
incorrect_navigation.description: Agent executed correct operation, but App navigated to unexpected page

unexpected_popup.label: Unexpected Popup
unexpected_popup.description: Unexpected system or app popup interrupted the task

page_load_timeout.label: Page Load Timeout
page_load_timeout.description: Page remained in loading state, unable to enter interactive state

app_crash.label: App Crash
app_crash.description: Application crashed or was forcibly closed by system

state_reversal.label: State Reversal
state_reversal.description: Previously completed operation results were unexpectedly reverted

precondition.label: Task Precondition Issue
precondition.description: An evidenced unmet prerequisite involving account access, content, features, matching results, or business limits.
